messages.subject: Error in makeStart
parts:
Hello, 

This error appears when I try to run my data in R. In my capture file, there are 26 known puma detections, so I am not sure how to fix this error or what it means to "set manually or select different session with details autoini."

> fit<-secr.fit(MRCH,buffer=4*initialsigma,trace=FALSE, start=list(D=0.0001, g0=0.1, sigma=1000),detectfn="EX")

Error in makeStart(start, parindx, capthist, mask, detectfn, link, details,  :
  too few values session 1 to determine start;
set manually or select different session with details autoini

-Sarah

messages.author: 118cea91a1619106
messages.subject: Re: Error in makeStart
parts:
I'm not sure why that fails. How many individuals do you have? The
autoini message is irrelevant if you have a single session, and you
are already trying to provide start.
This works with the MRCH from secr-markresight.pdf:
secr.fit(MRCH, buffer=4*20,trace=FALSE, start=list(D=1, g0=0.1,
sigma=20),detectfn="EX" )
Perhaps try
fit<-secr.fit(MRCH,buffer=4*initialsigma,trace=FALSE, start = c(D =
log(0.0001), g0 = logit(0.1), sigma = log(1000), pID =
logit(0.9)),detectfn="EX")
or use fixed=list(pID=1)
Murray

messages.subject: Re: Error in makeStart
parts: The error message is fairly explicit: new individuals should not appear on sighting-only occasions (unless this is a sighting-only model). Perhaps there's an error in your model specification. And a reality check: capture-recapture cannot produce meaningful results with a sample size of 3.
